posts.title: Movies have led me to believe…
posts.description: All old buildings are home to trained flocks of choreographed, jump-scare pigeons in the dust-laden rafters. Killers can turn rusty doorknobs and cross the most decrepit and warped hardwood floor without making any measurable sounds, but their victims’ tiniest movements clock in around 92 decibels. Everyone but me swallows pills without water with no problems. […]
